tools.name: cppjs_detect_framework
tools.description: Inspect a project directory and identify its bundler / runtime (vite, webpack, rspack, rollup, nextjs, react-native-cli, react-native-expo, cloudflare-worker, nodejs, vanilla). Returns a JSON match plus the recommended cpp.js integration playbook URL. Wraps scripts/detect-framework.js from the cpp.js repo.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory. Defaults to the MCP server's cwd.

scriptPath.description: Override path to detect-framework.js. Defaults to the bundled copy in the cpp.js repo.

tools.name: cppjs_list_packages
tools.description: Return the catalog of @cpp.js/package-* libraries shipped by cpp.js, with library name, category, supported architectures (wasm/android/ios), and what they enable. Use this BEFORE suggesting the user write their own bindings — many common libraries already have prebuilt packages.

tools.name: cppjs_recommend
tools.description: Given a use case description, return the matching cpp.js workflow: integrate an existing prebuilt package, write a new package wrapper, or just consume the user's own C++ inline. Returns a routing payload pointing at the right playbook URL and slash command.

useCase.description: Free-text description of what the user is trying to do. e.g. "add GDAL to my Vite app", "wrap libsodium so others can use it".

target.description: Where the C++ will run. Defaults to "unsure".

tools.name: cppjs_scaffold_package
tools.description: Create a new cppjs-package-<name> directory tree (wasm + android + ios sub-arches) by copying the cppjs-package-zlib template and rewriting names, scope, license, and library symbols. Wraps scripts/scaffold-package.js. Must run from inside the cpp.js monorepo.

name.description: Short package name, e.g. "libsodium" → produces cppjs-package-libsodium.

scope.description: npm scope. Pass "" (empty) for community / user-org unscoped packages. Defaults to "@cpp.js".

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Defaults to MIT.

lib.description: Override the linker library name (lib<lib>.a). Defaults to <name>.

output.description: Override output directory. Defaults to cppjs-packages/cppjs-package-<name>/.

force.description: Overwrite an existing target directory. Defaults to false.

tools.name: cppjs_doctor
tools.description: Run the doctor.sh script to verify Node, pnpm, git, Docker, Android SDK/NDK, and Xcode. Returns the report verbatim. Best for diagnosing "why won't my package build" before invoking build_package.

tools.name: cppjs_build_package
tools.description: Invoke pnpm --filter to build the wasm / android / ios sub-arches of a given package. Long-running (minutes per arch). Must run from inside the cpp.js monorepo. Wasm + Android build on Linux/macOS; iOS only on macOS.

name.description: Package short name (without "cppjs-package-" prefix). e.g. "zlib" builds @cpp.js/package-zlib-{wasm,android,ios}.

arch.description: Which arch to build. Defaults to "all".

tools.name: cppjs_check_native_versions
tools.description: Compare each cppjs-package-*'s nativeVersion against the latest upstream release (GitHub releases / tags / project HTML download index). With update=true, auto-bump every package.json that's behind. Must run from inside the cpp.js monorepo.

update.description: When true, write new nativeVersion values to package.json. When false (default), report only.

tools.name: cppjs_cloud_build_package
tools.description: Reserved for future cloud build service. Not implemented in the open-source MCP — local builds via cppjs_build_package work everywhere except iOS-on-non-macOS. Calling this tool returns a "not implemented" message and a pointer to local-build alternatives.

tools.name: cppjs_get_api_reference
tools.description: Return the canonical reference document for a cpp.js API surface. Use BEFORE answering questions about initCppJs(opts), cppjs.config.js fields, cppjs.build.js hooks, OPFS / persistent storage / filesystem, threading (st vs mt), useWorker, COOP/COEP, or edge-runtime limits. The 6 topics map 1:1 to docs/api/*.md files. Reads the file from the local cpp.js checkout when available; otherwise returns the GitHub URL the agent can fetch.

topic.description: Which doc to return. index = the decision-tree landing page; init = initCppJs(opts) runtime API; config = cppjs.config.js (consumer build-time); build = cppjs.build.js (package author only); filesystem = OPFS / memfs / node-fs / edge fs decision tree; threading = runtime st vs mt + useWorker + COOP/COEP + edge limits; binding-rules = rules for writing C++ that cpp.js can auto-bind; swig = manual SWIG .i escape hatch; state = state and target object shapes for cppjs.build.js hooks; overrides = catalog of 20 override mechanisms (least to most invasive); troubleshooting = common errors mapped to fixes + tribal-knowledge gotchas; performance = default Emscripten / CMake flags + safe-override guide; lifecycle = JS-side memory management (none needed) + TypeScript notes.
